name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps (Grand Prix)

career.layoutCall: Grand Prix (7.004 km): GB3 2021-22 and Euroformula Open 2023 (qualifying 2:11.7-2:20.4). Run-off works at Raidillon, La Source, Les Combes, Blanchimont and Stavelot between his 2021 and 2022 races; the track line is unchanged (research notes item 11). OSM loop through Speaker's Corner (the car layout), not OSM's 'Moto layout' chicane.

meta.heightsNote: OSM height or building:levels x 3.4 m + 1 m where tagged (real: true); otherwise defaults, not data: 6 m buildings, 8 m grandstands, 4 m bleachers; Overture footprints 6 m
meta.treesNote: trees from OSM woods (one per 9 m), tree rows and single trees, and ESA WorldCover tree cover (one per 10 m cell) where OSM has no wood; positions jittered up to 3-4 m by a fixed hash; none drawn by hand

circuit.startFinishNote: start/finish at the point [50.4437, 5.9661] (the pit straight between the Bus Stop and La Source, beside the middle of the F1 pit lane (OSM way 323851541); OSM's only start-finish node (1404684961) sits 1 km south by the kart area, so it is not used; position along the straight approximate (within about 150 m))

model.pitNote: OSM way 323851541 ("pit lane"), 720 m, nearest the start/finish (14 m)
